profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I build software and I run the projects that ship it.
I’m a full-stack engineer with 8+ years of experience who now works as both Software Engineer and IT Project Manager. Some days I’m writing React and .NET Core; others I’m running sprint planning, untangling requirements with stakeholders, and keeping a release on track. Doing both means my plans are grounded in how the code actually works, and my code is shaped by what the business actually needs.

What I bring:
→ Engineering: I’ve modernized legacy interfaces into fast React apps, built and maintained .NET Core Web APIs on SQL Server, and turned clunky reporting into interactive dashboards people actually use.
→ Delivery: Agile/Scrum in practice, not just on paper: backlog grooming, sprint planning, stand-ups and retros, plus being the person who translates between engineering, design and the business.
→ Ownership: I’m comfortable taking a product from first conversation to launch and then supporting it once real users arrive.

Toolkit:
Engineering: React, Redux, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, C#, ASP.NET / .NET Core Web API, SQL Server, MySQL, Supabase, Three.js, Git, Vercel
Project management: Agile/Scrum, Jira, Trello, Asana, Slack, stakeholder management, requirements gathering, third-party API integrations

I’m open to roles where engineering and delivery overlap: Technical Project Manager, Technical Program Manager, Engineering Lead, or Senior Full-Stack Engineer on a team that values ownership.

Portfolio: 
www.studioadk.com

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: React.js · JavaScript · C# · ASP.NET Core · ASP.NET Web API · SQL · ReactJS · ASP.NET · .NET Core

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
Kidian is a marketplace app for parties and events - platform that connects users to fun & interesting party entertainment for kids and adults

- Developed as front-end developer on web application project that helps functionality of entire web page for the company
- Developed reusable components with combination of JQuery, Javascript, ReactJS and ECMAScript 2015 (ES6) transpiled through Babel by webpack to patch defects
Optimized old code and added new features such as lazy loading and conversion of CSS3 files to Sass
- Adhered to agile processes, communicating status through Trello boards and daily standups, and using TFS to manage shared codebase and perform continuous integration builds

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Babel Dabble is a real-time competitive calligraphy platform that makes it fun to master writing Chinese characters. Users can also practice individually when no Internet connectivity is available. In addition, it provides a learning management system for teachers to create assignments for students to complete by using the same interactive writing canvas used during competition

- Contributed to every layer of full stack for developing web application
- Developed client side page with combination of React and AngularJS using
ECMAScript 2015 (ES6) transpiled through Babel by webpack
- Built server using ASP.NET Web API 2 on .NET Framework 4.6. WebSockets via
SignalR were used for real-time gameplay
- Managed database via SQL Server using stored procedures and incorporated new
JSON functionality to improve back-end performance
- Integrated 3rd party services: Summernote, SendGrid, Service Worker to provide
optimal services to the users
- Adhered to Agile processes, communicating status through trello boards and daily
stand-ups, and using TFS to manage shared codebase and perform continuous integration builds

positions.title: Financial Analyst / Underwriter
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Performed financial analysis and monitor financial trends of over 120 loan portfolio
- Analyzed and closed over 35 new SBA loans under SBA 7a guide line	
- Design an Excel-based financial modeling tools to prepare an examination of financial forecast on new loans and determined complete feasibility study

positions.title: Financial Analyst / Underwriter
positions.description:
- Performed financial analysis and monitor financial trends of over 120 loan portfolio
- Performed financial analysis on the performance of $38 million loan portfolio comprised of both SBA and Commercial loan by running advanced formulas and functions

positions.title: Co-Op
positions.description:
- Analyzed current social media contents to strategize brand awareness.
- Analyzed and implemented new website contents and format.
- Assisted in implementing new social media presence and getting visibility of the brand.
- Coordinated and planed new project plan for three different groups.

positions.title: Database Administrator Intern
positions.description:
- Supported engineers in cross-functional teams working on new products and solutions, or    updating existing products.
- Managed and organized over 30,000 test data folders via HP Quality Center; SQL.
- Worked on project in team setting to support the delivery and documentation of new products.
